FSIR-BD contains 38,353 images and 303 queries, with 82% comprising the test corpus (averaging per query 37 positives, ground truth matches, and significant number of hard negatives) and 18% forming the few-shot reference corpus (FSR) of exemplar positive and hard negative images. Additionally, we propose two novel retrieval optimization methods leveraging single shot or few shot reference examples in the FSR to improve performance. Both methods are compatible with any pre-trained image encoder, making them applicable to existing large-scale environments. Our experiments demonstrate that: (1) FSIR-BD provides a challenging benchmark for image retrieval; and (2) our optimization methods outperform existing baselines as measured by mean Average Precision (mAP). Further research into FSIR optimization methods will help narrow the gap between machine and human-level understanding, particularly for compositional reasoning from limited examples.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了少样本文本到图像检索任务(FSIR)及其基准数据集FSIR-BD，针对组合查询和分布外图像-文本对，并提出了两种兼容现有预训练编码器的少样本优化方法。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉语言模型在多模态任务中表现出色，但在组合查询和分布外图像-文本对方面存在困难。受人类从少量示例中学习的能力启发，研究者希望通过少样本学习方法解决图像检索中的这一性能差距。
AI.method: 1. 提出了少样本文本到图像检索(FSIR)任务及其基准数据集FSIR-BD，包含38,353张图像和303个查询，专门针对组合查询和OOD场景。2. 提出了两种新颖的检索优化方法，利用单样本或少样本参考示例来提升性能，这些方法与任何预训练图像编码器兼容。
AI.result: 1. FSIR-BD为图像检索提供了一个具有挑战性的基准。2. 提出的优化方法在平均精度均值(mAP)指标上优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FSIR优化方法的进一步研究将有助于缩小机器与人类理解之间的差距，特别是在从有限示例中进行组合推理方面。该工作为少样本图像检索领域提供了首个专门基准和有效的优化方法。

title: THFM: A Unified Video Foundation Model for 4D Human Perception and Beyond
summary: We present THFM, a unified video foundation model for human-centric perception that jointly addresses dense tasks (depth, normals, segmentation, dense pose) and sparse tasks (2d/3d keypoint estimation) within a single architecture. THFM is derived from a pretrained text-to-video diffusion model, repurposed as a single-forward-pass perception model and augmented with learnable tokens for sparse predictions. Modulated by the text prompt, our single unified model is capable of performing various perception tasks. Crucially, our model is on-par or surpassing state-of-the-art specialized models on a variety of benchmarks despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data (i.e.~without training on real-world or benchmark specific data). We further highlight intriguing emergent properties of our model, which we attribute to the underlying diffusion-based video representation. For example, our model trained on videos with a single human in the scene generalizes to multiple humans and other object classes such as anthropomorphic characters and animals -- a capability that hasn't been demonstrated in the past.

AI.tldr: THFM是一个统一的人类中心视频基础模型，能在单一架构中同时处理密集任务（深度、法线、分割、密集姿态）和稀疏任务（2D/3D关键点估计），基于预训练文本到视频扩散模型构建，仅用合成数据训练就能达到或超越专门模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类中心感知模型通常是专门化的，针对不同任务需要不同的架构和训练。研究者希望开发一个统一的视频基础模型，能够同时处理多种密集和稀疏感知任务，减少模型复杂性和训练成本。
AI.method: THFM基于预训练的文本到视频扩散模型，将其重新用于单次前向传播的感知模型。通过添加可学习令牌来处理稀疏预测任务，并使用文本提示来调制模型，使其能够执行不同的感知任务。模型仅使用合成数据进行训练。
AI.result: THFM在多种基准测试中达到或超越了专门模型的表现，尽管仅使用合成数据训练。模型展现出有趣的涌现特性，例如从单人类场景训练后能泛化到多人类场景、拟人化角色和动物，这在以往研究中未曾展示过。
AI.conclusion: THFM展示了基于扩散的视频表示在统一人类中心感知任务中的潜力，仅用合成数据就能实现强大的泛化能力，为视频基础模型的发展提供了新方向。

title: findsylls: A Language-Agnostic Toolkit for Syllable-Level Speech Tokenization and Embedding
comment: 4 pages + 2 for references, disclosures & acknowledgements; currently under review
summary: Syllable-level units offer compact and linguistically meaningful representations for spoken language modeling and unsupervised word discovery, but research on syllabification remains fragmented across disparate implementations, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce findsylls, a modular, language-agnostic toolkit that unifies classical syllable detectors and end-to-end syllabifiers under a common interface for syllable segmentation, embedding extraction, and multi-granular evaluation. The toolkit implements and standardizes widely used methods (e.g., Sylber, VG-HuBERT) and allows their components to be recombined, enabling controlled comparisons of representations, algorithms, and token rates. We demonstrate findsylls on English and Spanish corpora and on new hand-annotated data from Kono, an underdocumented Central Mande language, illustrating how a single framework can support reproducible syllable-level experiments across both high-resource and under-resourced settings.

AI.tldr: findsylls是一个模块化、语言无关的音节分割工具包，统一了经典音节检测器和端到端音节分割器，支持音节分割、嵌入提取和多粒度评估。
AI.motivation: 音节级单元为口语建模和无监督词发现提供了紧凑且具有语言学意义的表示，但现有音节分割研究在不同实现、数据集和评估协议上存在碎片化问题。
AI.method: 开发了findsylls工具包，统一了经典音节检测器（如Sylber）和端到端音节分割器（如VG-HuBERT）的接口，支持模块化组件重组，实现表示、算法和标记率的受控比较。
AI.result: 在英语和西班牙语语料库以及新标注的Kono语言数据上展示了findsylls的功能，证明该框架能在高资源和资源匮乏环境下支持可重复的音节级实验。
AI.conclusion: findsylls为音节分割研究提供了统一框架，解决了该领域碎片化问题，支持跨语言和资源环境的可重复实验，对口语建模和词发现研究具有重要意义。

title: Shared Representation for 3D Pose Estimation, Action Classification, and Progress Prediction from Tactile Signals
summary: Estimating human pose, classifying actions, and predicting movement progress are essential for human-robot interaction. While vision-based methods suffer from occlusion and privacy concerns in realistic environments, tactile sensing avoids these issues. However, prior tactile-based approaches handle each task separately, leading to suboptimal performance. In this study, we propose a Shared COnvolutional Transformer for Tactile Inference (SCOTTI) that learns a shared representation to simultaneously address three separate prediction tasks: 3D human pose estimation, action class categorization, and action completion progress estimation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explore action progress prediction using foot tactile signals from custom wireless insole sensors. This unified approach leverages the mutual benefits of multi-task learning, enabling the model to achieve improved performance across all three tasks compared to learning them independently. Experimental results demonstrate that SCOTTI outperforms existing approaches across all three tasks. Additionally, we introduce a novel dataset collected from 15 participants performing various activities and exercises, with 7 hours of total duration, across eight different activities.

AI.tldr: SCOTTI：首个使用足部触觉信号同时处理3D人体姿态估计、动作分类和动作完成进度预测的多任务学习模型，通过共享卷积Transformer架构提升性能
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的方法在实际环境中存在遮挡和隐私问题，而触觉感知可以避免这些问题。现有触觉方法单独处理每个任务导致性能不佳，需要统一的解决方案
AI.method: 提出SCOTTI（共享卷积Transformer触觉推理）模型，使用共享表示同时处理三个预测任务：3D人体姿态估计、动作分类和动作完成进度估计。使用定制无线鞋垫传感器收集足部触觉信号
AI.result: SCOTTI在所有三个任务上都优于现有方法。同时收集了包含15名参与者、7小时总时长、8种不同活动的新数据集
AI.conclusion: 这是首个探索使用足部触觉信号进行动作进度预测的工作，统一的多任务学习方法通过利用任务间的相互益处，在所有三个任务上都实现了比独立学习更好的性能

title: From Human Cognition to Neural Activations: Probing the Computational Primitives of Spatial Reasoning in LLMs
summary: As spatial intelligence becomes an increasingly important capability for foundation models, it remains unclear whether large language models' (LLMs) performance on spatial reasoning benchmarks reflects structured internal spatial representations or reliance on linguistic heuristics. We address this question from a mechanistic perspective by examining how spatial information is internally represented and used. Drawing on computational theories of human spatial cognition, we decompose spatial reasoning into three primitives, relational composition, representational transformation, and stateful spatial updating, and design controlled task families for each. We evaluate multilingual LLMs in English, Chinese, and Arabic under single pass inference, and analyze internal representations using linear probing, sparse autoencoder based feature analysis, and causal interventions. We find that task relevant spatial information is encoded in intermediate layers and can causally influence behavior, but these representations are transient, fragmented across task families, and weakly integrated into final predictions. Cross linguistic analysis further reveals mechanistic degeneracy, where similar behavioral performance arises from distinct internal pathways. Overall, our results suggest that current LLMs exhibit limited and context dependent spatial representations rather than robust, general purpose spatial reasoning, highlighting the need for mechanistic evaluation beyond benchmark accuracy.

AI.tldr: LLMs的空间推理能力并非基于结构化内部空间表征，而是依赖语言启发式，其空间信息编码是瞬态、碎片化且弱整合的
AI.motivation: 随着空间智能成为基础模型的重要能力，需要明确LLMs在空间推理基准测试中的表现是反映了结构化内部空间表征还是依赖语言启发式
AI.method: 基于人类空间认知计算理论，将空间推理分解为三个原语（关系组合、表征转换、状态空间更新），设计控制任务族，使用线性探测、稀疏自编码器特征分析和因果干预分析多语言LLMs的内部表征
AI.result: 任务相关空间信息在中间层编码并能因果影响行为，但这些表征是瞬态的、跨任务族碎片化的，且弱整合到最终预测中；跨语言分析显示机制退化，相似行为表现来自不同内部路径
AI.conclusion: 当前LLMs表现出有限且上下文依赖的空间表征而非鲁棒的通用空间推理，强调需要超越基准准确性的机制评估

title: VLAgeBench: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models for Zero-Shot Human Age Estimation
summary: Human age estimation from facial images represents a challenging computer vision task with significant applications in biometrics, healthcare, and human-computer interaction. While traditional deep learning approaches require extensive labeled datasets and domain-specific training, recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) offer the potential for zero-shot age estimation. This study presents a comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of state-of-the-art Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) for facial age estimation, a task traditionally dominated by domain-specific convolutional networks and supervised learning. We assess the performance of GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and LLaMA 3.2 Vision on two benchmark datasets, UTKFace and FG-NET, without any fine-tuning or task-specific adaptation. Using eight evaluation metrics, including MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, MBE, $R^2$, CCC, and $\pm$5-year accuracy, we demonstrate that general-purpose LVLMs can deliver competitive performance in zero-shot settings. Our findings highlight the emergent capabilities of LVLMs for accurate biometric age estimation and position these models as promising tools for real-world applications. Additionally, we highlight performance disparities linked to image quality and demographic subgroups, underscoring the need for fairness-aware multimodal inference. This work introduces a reproducible benchmark and positions LVLMs as promising tools for real-world applications in forensic science, healthcare monitoring, and human-computer interaction. The benchmark focuses on strict zero-shot inference without fine-tuning and highlights remaining challenges related to prompt sensitivity, interpretability, computational cost, and demographic fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文对GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet和LLaMA 3.2 Vision等大型视觉语言模型进行了零样本面部年龄估计的全面评估，发现这些通用模型在UTKFace和FG-NET数据集上无需微调即可达到与专业模型竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统面部年龄估计方法需要大量标注数据和领域特定训练，而大型视觉语言模型的出现为零样本年龄估计提供了可能。本研究旨在评估这些通用模型在面部年龄估计任务中的零样本能力，探索其在生物识别、医疗保健和人机交互等领域的应用潜力。
AI.method: 在UTKFace和FG-NET两个基准数据集上，对GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet和LLaMA 3.2 Vision三种大型视觉语言模型进行零样本评估，不使用任何微调或任务特定适应。采用八种评估指标：平均绝对误差、均方误差、均方根误差、平均绝对百分比误差、平均偏差误差、决定系数、一致性相关系数和±5年准确率。
AI.result: 研究表明，通用大型视觉语言模型在零样本设置下能够提供具有竞争力的面部年龄估计性能。同时发现性能差异与图像质量和人口统计子群体相关，强调了公平感知多模态推理的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 大型视觉语言模型在零样本面部年龄估计中展现出新兴能力，可作为法医科学、医疗监测和人机交互等实际应用的有前景工具。研究建立了可复现的基准，并指出了在提示敏感性、可解释性、计算成本和人口统计公平性方面仍存在的挑战。

title: Switch Attention: Towards Dynamic and Fine-grained Hybrid Transformers
summary: The attention mechanism has been the core component in modern transformer architectures. However, the computation of standard full attention scales quadratically with the sequence length, serving as a major bottleneck in long-context language modeling. Sliding window attention restricts the context length for better efficiency at the cost of narrower receptive fields. While existing efforts attempt to take the benefits from both sides by building hybrid models, they often resort to static, heuristically designed alternating patterns that limit efficient allocation of computation in various scenarios. In this paper, we propose Switch Attention (SwiAttn), a novel hybrid transformer that enables dynamic and fine-grained routing between full attention and sliding window attention. For each token at each transformer layer, SwiAttn dynamically routes the computation to either a full-attention branch for global information aggregation or a sliding-window branch for efficient local pattern matching. An adaptive regularization objective is designed to encourage the model towards efficiency. Moreover, we adopt continual pretraining to optimize the model, transferring the full attention architecture to the hybrid one. Extensive experiments are conducted on twenty-three benchmark datasets across both regular (4K) and long (32K) context lengths, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出Switch Attention（SwiAttn），一种动态混合注意力机制，能在全注意力和滑动窗口注意力之间进行细粒度路由，解决长序列建模中计算效率与感受野的平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 标准全注意力机制在长序列建模中存在二次计算复杂度瓶颈，而滑动窗口注意力虽然高效但感受野受限。现有混合模型多采用静态启发式交替模式，无法根据场景动态分配计算资源。
AI.method: 提出SwiAttn，在每个transformer层的每个token处动态路由计算到全注意力分支（全局信息聚合）或滑动窗口分支（高效局部模式匹配），采用自适应正则化目标鼓励效率，并通过持续预训练优化模型。
AI.result: 在23个基准数据集上进行了广泛实验，涵盖常规（4K）和长（32K）上下文长度，证明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SwiAttn通过动态细粒度路由机制，有效平衡了长序列建模中的计算效率与模型性能，相比静态混合模式具有更好的适应性。

title: Word Alignment-Based Evaluation of Uniform Meaning Representations
summary: Comparison and evaluation of graph-based representations of sentence meaning is a challenge because competing representations of the same sentence may have different number of nodes, and it is not obvious which nodes should be compared to each other. Existing approaches favor node mapping that maximizes $F_1$ score over node relations and attributes, regardless whether the similarity is intentional or accidental; consequently, the identified mismatches in values of node attributes are not useful for any detailed error analysis. We propose a node-matching algorithm that allows comparison of multiple Uniform Meaning Representations (UMR) of one sentence and that takes advantage of node-word alignments, inherently available in UMR. We compare it with previously used approaches, in particular smatch (the de-facto standard in AMR evaluation), and argue that sensitivity to word alignment makes the comparison of meaning representations more intuitive and interpretable, while avoiding the NP-hard search problem inherent in smatch. A script implementing the method is freely available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于节点-词语对齐的UMR图匹配算法，相比传统的smatch方法更直观可解释，避免了NP-hard搜索问题。
AI.motivation: 现有图结构句子意义表示比较方法存在两个主要问题：1) 不同表示可能有不同节点数，节点对应关系不明确；2) 现有方法（如smatch）最大化F1分数时无法区分有意相似和偶然相似，导致节点属性不匹配分析不实用。
AI.method: 提出一种节点匹配算法，利用UMR中固有的节点-词语对齐信息，比较同一句子的多个UMR表示。该方法避免了smatch中的NP-hard搜索问题。
AI.result: 与smatch等现有方法相比，新方法对词语对齐更敏感，使意义表示比较更直观可解释，同时避免了计算复杂性。
AI.conclusion: 基于节点-词语对齐的UMR比较方法比传统方法更实用，提供了更直观的错误分析能力，且算法实现已公开可用。

title: Bridging Pixels and Words: Mask-Aware Local Semantic Fusion for Multimodal Media Verification
summary: As multimodal misinformation becomes more sophisticated, its detection and grounding are crucial. However, current multimodal verification methods, relying on passive holistic fusion, struggle with sophisticated misinformation. Due to 'feature dilution,' global alignments tend to average out subtle local semantic inconsistencies, effectively masking the very conflicts they are designed to find. We introduce MaLSF (Mask-aware Local Semantic Fusion), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm to active, bidirectional verification, mimicking human cognitive cross-referencing. MaLSF utilizes mask-label pairs as semantic anchors to bridge pixels and words. Its core mechanism features two innovations: 1) a Bidirectional Cross-modal Verification (BCV) module that acts as an interrogator, using parallel query streams (Text-as-Query and Image-as-Query) to explicitly pinpoint conflicts; and 2) a Hierarchical Semantic Aggregation (HSA) module that intelligently aggregates these multi-granularity conflict signals for task-specific reasoning. In addition, to extract fine-grained mask-label pairs, we introduce a set of diverse mask-label pair extraction parsers. MaLSF achieves state-of-the-art performance on both the DGM4 and multimodal fake news detection tasks. Extensive ablation studies and visualization results further verify its effectiveness and interpretability.

AI.tldr: MaLSF是一个用于多模态虚假信息检测的新框架，通过掩码感知的局部语义融合和双向跨模态验证来识别图像-文本之间的局部语义不一致，在DGM4和多模态假新闻检测任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态验证方法依赖被动的整体融合，难以应对复杂的虚假信息。由于"特征稀释"问题，全局对齐会平均掉细微的局部语义不一致，掩盖了本应发现的冲突。
AI.method: 提出MaLSF框架，采用主动双向验证范式。核心机制包括：1) 双向跨模态验证(BCV)模块，使用并行查询流(文本作为查询和图像作为查询)显式定位冲突；2) 分层语义聚合(HSA)模块，智能聚合多粒度冲突信号进行任务特定推理。此外，引入多样化的掩码-标签对提取解析器来获取细粒度语义锚点。
AI.result: MaLSF在DGM4和多模态假新闻检测任务上实现了最先进的性能。广泛的消融研究和可视化结果进一步验证了其有效性和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MaLSF通过主动、双向的验证范式，有效解决了多模态虚假信息检测中的特征稀释问题，能够识别局部语义不一致，为多模态验证提供了新的研究方向。

title: Why Models Know But Don't Say: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Divergence Between Thinking Tokens and Answers in Open-Weight Reasoning Models
summary: Extended-thinking models expose a second text-generation channel ("thinking tokens") alongside the user-visible answer. This study examines 12 open-weight reasoning models on MMLU and GPQA questions paired with misleading hints. Among the 10,506 cases where models actually followed the hint (choosing the hint's target over the ground truth), each case is classified by whether the model acknowledges the hint in its thinking tokens, its answer text, both, or neither. In 55.4% of these cases the model's thinking tokens contain hint-related keywords that the visible answer omits entirely, a pattern termed *thinking-answer divergence*. The reverse (answer-only acknowledgment) is near-zero (0.5%), confirming that the asymmetry is directional. Hint type shapes the pattern sharply: sycophancy is the most *transparent* hint, with 58.8% of sycophancy-influenced cases acknowledging the professor's authority in both channels, while consistency (72.2%) and unethical (62.7%) hints are dominated by thinking-only acknowledgment. Models also vary widely, from near-total divergence (Step-3.5-Flash: 94.7%) to relative transparency (Qwen3.5-27B: 19.6%). These results show that answer-text-only monitoring misses more than half of all hint-influenced reasoning and that thinking-token access, while necessary, still leaves 11.8% of cases with no verbalized acknowledgment in either channel.

AI.tldr: 研究发现推理模型存在"思考-回答分歧"现象：当模型受误导提示影响时，55.4%的情况下思考令牌包含提示相关关键词而可见回答完全省略，而反向情况仅0.5%，表明这种不对称是方向性的。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究扩展思考模型在存在误导提示时的行为模式，特别是模型内部思考令牌与外部可见回答之间的差异，以评估仅监控回答文本是否足以检测模型受提示影响的情况。
AI.method: 研究分析了12个开源推理模型在MMLU和GPQA问题上的表现，这些问题都配有误导提示。在10,506个模型实际遵循提示（选择提示目标而非正确答案）的案例中，对每个案例进行分类：模型是否在思考令牌、回答文本、两者或两者中都不承认提示。
AI.result: 55.4%的案例存在思考-回答分歧（思考令牌包含提示关键词而回答省略），反向情况仅0.5%。提示类型影响显著：奉承提示最透明（58.8%在双通道承认），一致性（72.2%）和不道德（62.7%）提示主要呈现思考仅承认。模型间差异巨大，从Step-3.5-Flash的94.7%分歧率到Qwen3.5-27B的19.6%透明度。
AI.conclusion: 仅监控回答文本会错过超过一半的提示影响推理案例，而访问思考令牌虽然必要，仍有11.8%的案例在两个通道中都没有言语化承认。这表明需要更全面的监控方法来检测模型受外部提示影响的情况。

title: MuDD: A Multimodal Deception Detection Dataset and GSR-Guided Progressive Distillation for Non-Contact Deception Detection
summary: Non-contact automatic deception detection remains challenging because visual and auditory deception cues often lack stable cross-subject patterns. In contrast, galvanic skin response (GSR) provides more reliable physiological cues and has been widely used in contact-based deception detection. In this work, we leverage stable deception-related knowledge in GSR to guide representation learning in non-contact modalities through cross-modal knowledge distillation. A key obstacle, however, is the lack of a suitable dataset for this setting. To address this, we introduce MuDD, a large-scale Multimodal Deception Detection dataset containing recordings from 130 participants over 690 minutes. In addition to video, audio, and GSR, MuDD also provides Photoplethysmography, heart rate, and personality traits, supporting broader scientific studies of deception. Based on this dataset, we propose GSR-guided Progressive Distillation (GPD), a cross-modal distillation framework for mitigating the negative transfer caused by the large modality mismatch between GSR and non-contact signals. The core innovation of GPD is the integration of progressive feature-level and digit-level distillation with dynamic routing, which allows the model to adaptively determine how teacher knowledge should be transferred during training, leading to more stable cross-modal knowledge transfer. Extensive experiments and visualizations show that GPD outperforms existing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on both deception detection and concealed-digit identification.

AI.tldr: 通过跨模态知识蒸馏，利用GSR的稳定欺骗线索指导非接触模态学习，提出GSR引导的渐进蒸馏框架，在大型多模态欺骗检测数据集上实现SOTA性能
AI.motivation: 非接触式自动欺骗检测面临挑战，因为视觉和听觉欺骗线索缺乏稳定的跨被试模式。相比之下，皮肤电反应(GSR)提供更可靠的生理线索，但现有数据集不足，且GSR与非接触信号之间存在大的模态不匹配问题
AI.method: 提出GSR引导的渐进蒸馏(GPD)框架，整合渐进特征级和数字级蒸馏与动态路由，自适应确定教师知识在训练过程中的传递方式。同时构建MuDD大型多模态欺骗检测数据集，包含130名参与者690分钟记录
AI.result: GPD在欺骗检测和隐藏数字识别任务上优于现有方法，实现最先进性能。实验和可视化验证了方法的有效性
AI.conclusion: 通过跨模态知识蒸馏，利用GSR的稳定欺骗知识指导非接触模态学习是有效的。GPD框架解决了模态不匹配导致的负迁移问题，为欺骗检测提供了新思路

title: Low-Rank-Modulated Functa: Exploring the Latent Space of Implicit Neural Representations for Interpretable Ultrasound Video Analysis
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a powerful framework for continuous image representation learning. In Functa-based approaches, each image is encoded as a latent modulation vector that conditions a shared INR, enabling strong reconstruction performance. However, the structure and interpretability of the corresponding latent spaces remain largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the latent space of Functa-based models for ultrasound videos and propose Low-Rank-Modulated Functa (LRM-Functa), a novel architecture that enforces a low-rank adaptation of modulation vectors in the time-resolved latent space. When applied to cardiac ultrasound, the resulting latent space exhibits clearly structured periodic trajectories, facilitating visualization and interpretability of temporal patterns. The latent space can be traversed to sample novel frames, revealing smooth transitions along the cardiac cycle, and enabling direct readout of end-diastolic (ED) and end-systolic (ES) frames without additional model training. We show that LRM-Functa outperforms prior methods in unsupervised ED and ES frame detection, while compressing each video frame to as low as rank k=2 without sacrificing competitive downstream performance on ejection fraction prediction. Evaluations on out-of-distribution frame selection in a cardiac point-of-care dataset, as well as on lung ultrasound for B-line classification, demonstrate the generalizability of our approach. Overall, LRM-Functa provides a compact, interpretable, and generalizable framework for ultrasound video analysis. The code is available at https://github.com/JuliaWolleb/LRM_Functa.

AI.tldr: 提出LRM-Functa架构，通过低秩调制向量增强超声视频隐式神经表示的潜在空间结构性和可解释性，在心脏超声中实现周期性轨迹可视化，无需额外训练即可识别心动周期关键帧。
AI.motivation: 现有Functa方法虽然能有效重建图像，但其潜在空间的结构和可解释性尚未充分探索，特别是在超声视频分析中缺乏对时间模式的直观理解。
AI.method: 提出低秩调制Functa（LRM-Functa）架构，在时间分辨的潜在空间中强制实施调制向量的低秩适应，使心脏超声的潜在空间呈现结构化周期性轨迹。
AI.result: LRM-Functa在无监督ED/ES帧检测上优于现有方法，可将每帧压缩至秩k=2而不影响射血分数预测性能，在心脏和肺部超声任务中均表现出良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LRM-Functa为超声视频分析提供了一个紧凑、可解释且可泛化的框架，其结构化潜在空间便于可视化时间模式并直接读取心动周期关键帧。

title: When Identities Collapse: A Stress-Test Benchmark for Multi-Subject Personalization
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, accepted by CVPR 2026 Workshop P13N
summary: Subject-driven text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in preserving single identities, yet their ability to compose multiple interacting subjects remains largely unexplored and highly challenging. Existing evaluation protocols typically rely on global CLIP metrics, which are insensitive to local identity collapse and fail to capture the severity of multi-subject entanglement. In this paper, we identify a pervasive "Illusion of Scalability" in current models: while they excel at synthesizing 2-4 subjects in simple layouts, they suffer from catastrophic identity collapse when scaled to 6-10 subjects or tasked with complex physical interactions. To systematically expose this failure mode, we construct a rigorous stress-test benchmark comprising 75 prompts distributed across varying subject counts and interaction difficulties (Neutral, Occlusion, Interaction). Furthermore, we demonstrate that standard CLIP-based metrics are fundamentally flawed for this task, as they often assign high scores to semantically correct but identity-collapsed images (e.g., generating generic clones). To address this, we introduce the Subject Collapse Rate (SCR), a novel evaluation metric grounded in DINOv2's structural priors, which strictly penalizes local attention leakage and homogenization. Our extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models (MOSAIC, XVerse, PSR) reveals a precipitous drop in identity fidelity as scene complexity grows, with SCR approaching 100% at 10 subjects. We trace this collapse to the semantic shortcuts inherent in global attention routing, underscoring the urgent need for explicit physical disentanglement in future generative architectures.

AI.tldr: 论文发现现有主题驱动文本到图像扩散模型存在"可扩展性幻觉"，在合成6-10个主体或复杂交互时会出现灾难性身份崩溃，并提出新的评估指标SCR来量化这一问题。
AI.motivation: 现有主题驱动文本到图像模型在保持单个身份方面表现优异，但在合成多个交互主体时能力有限。当前评估方法依赖全局CLIP指标，无法检测局部身份崩溃和多主体纠缠问题，需要更系统的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建包含75个提示的严格压力测试基准，涵盖不同主体数量和交互难度（中性、遮挡、交互）。提出基于DINOv2结构先验的Subject Collapse Rate（SCR）评估指标，严格惩罚局部注意力泄漏和同质化现象。
AI.result: 对SOTA模型（MOSAIC、XVerse、PSR）的评估显示，随着场景复杂度增加，身份保真度急剧下降，在10个主体时SCR接近100%。发现崩溃源于全局注意力路由中的语义捷径。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型存在严重的可扩展性限制，标准CLIP指标存在根本缺陷。需要在未来生成架构中引入显式的物理解缠机制来解决多主体合成中的身份崩溃问题。

title: ClimateCheck 2026: Scientific Fact-Checking and Disinformation Narrative Classification of Climate-related Claims
summary: Automatically verifying climate-related claims against scientific literature is a challenging task, complicated by the specialised nature of scholarly evidence and the diversity of rhetorical strategies underlying climate disinformation. ClimateCheck 2026 is the second iteration of a shared task addressing this challenge, expanding on the 2025 edition with tripled training data and a new disinformation narrative classification task. Running from January to February 2026 on the CodaBench platform, the competition attracted 20 registered participants and 8 leaderboard submissions, with systems combining dense retrieval pipelines, cross-encoder ensembles, and large language models with structured hierarchical reasoning. In addition to standard evaluation metrics (Recall@K and Binary Preference), we adapt an automated framework to assess retrieval quality under incomplete annotations, exposing systematic biases in how conventional metrics rank systems. A cross-task analysis further reveals that not all climate disinformation is equally verifiable, potentially implicating how future fact-checking systems should be designed.

AI.tldr: ClimateCheck 2026是第二届气候相关声明自动验证竞赛，扩展了2025版，训练数据增加三倍并新增虚假信息叙事分类任务，吸引了20名参与者，系统结合了密集检索、交叉编码器集成和大型语言模型。
AI.motivation: 自动验证气候相关声明面临挑战，包括科学证据的专业性和气候虚假信息修辞策略的多样性，需要开发更有效的验证系统来应对气候虚假信息。
AI.method: 竞赛在CodaBench平台运行，参与者开发了结合密集检索管道、交叉编码器集成、大型语言模型与结构化分层推理的系统，并采用自适应评估框架处理不完整标注问题。
AI.result: 竞赛吸引了20名注册参与者和8个排行榜提交，通过跨任务分析发现并非所有气候虚假信息都同样可验证，揭示了传统评估指标在系统排名中存在的系统性偏差。
AI.conclusion: 气候虚假信息的可验证性存在差异，这对未来事实核查系统的设计有重要启示，需要更精细的评估方法来准确衡量检索系统的质量。

title: Finding Distributed Object-Centric Properties in Self-Supervised Transformers
summary: Self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) like DINO show an emergent ability to discover objects, typically observed in [CLS] token attention maps of the final layer. However, these maps often contain spurious activations resulting in poor localization of objects. This is because the [CLS] token, trained on an image-level objective, summarizes the entire image instead of focusing on objects. This aggregation dilutes the object-centric information existing in the local, patch-level interactions. We analyze this by computing inter-patch similarity using patch-level attention components (query, key, and value) across all layers. We find that: (1) Object-centric properties are encoded in the similarity maps derived from all three components ($q, k, v$), unlike prior work that uses only key features or the [CLS] token. (2) This object-centric information is distributed across the network, not just confined to the final layer. Based on these insights, we introduce Object-DINO, a training-free method that extracts this distributed object-centric information. Object-DINO clusters attention heads across all layers based on the similarities of their patches and automatically identifies the object-centric cluster corresponding to all objects. We demonstrate Object-DINO's effectiveness on two applications: enhancing unsupervised object discovery (+3.6 to +12.4 CorLoc gains) and mitigating object hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models by providing visual grounding. Our results demonstrate that using this distributed object-centric information improves downstream tasks without additional training.

AI.tldr: Object-DINO：一种无需训练的方法，通过分析ViT中所有层的patch级注意力组件（q,k,v）来提取分布式对象中心信息，提升无监督对象发现性能并缓解多模态大语言模型的对象幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 传统自监督ViT（如DINO）的[CLS]token注意力图虽然能发现对象，但常包含虚假激活导致定位不准，因为[CLS]token训练时关注整个图像而非特定对象，稀释了patch级交互中的对象中心信息。
AI.method: 通过分析所有层中patch级注意力组件（查询、键、值）的相似性图，发现对象中心信息分布在所有层中。提出Object-DINO方法：基于patch相似性对所有层的注意力头进行聚类，自动识别对应所有对象的对象中心簇。
AI.result: Object-DINO在无监督对象发现任务上获得+3.6到+12.4的CorLoc提升，并能通过提供视觉基础缓解多模态大语言模型的对象幻觉问题，无需额外训练即可改善下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 对象中心信息分布在ViT的所有层中，而不仅限于最后一层。利用这种分布式信息可以显著提升对象发现性能并缓解多模态模型中的幻觉问题，为自监督视觉表示提供了新的理解。

title: AMALIA Technical Report: A Fully Open Source Large Language Model for European Portuguese
comment: PROPOR 2026 - The 17th International Conference on Computational Processing of Portuguese
summary: Despite rapid progress in open large language models (LLMs), European Portuguese (pt-PT) remains underrepresented in both training data and native evaluation, with machine-translated benchmarks likely missing the variant's linguistic and cultural nuances. We introduce AMALIA, a fully open LLM that prioritizes pt-PT by using more high-quality pt-PT data during both the mid- and post-training stages. To evaluate pt-PT more faithfully, we release a suite of pt-PT benchmarks that includes translated standard tasks and four new datasets targeting pt-PT generation, linguistic competence, and pt-PT/pt-BR bias. Experiments show that AMALIA matches strong baselines on translated benchmarks while substantially improving performance on pt-PT-specific evaluations, supporting the case for targeted training and native benchmarking for European Portuguese.

AI.tldr: AMALIA是一个专门针对欧洲葡萄牙语(pt-PT)优化的开源大语言模型，通过增加高质量pt-PT数据训练，并发布了专门的pt-PT评估基准套件。
AI.motivation: 欧洲葡萄牙语在现有大语言模型的训练数据和评估中代表性不足，机器翻译的基准测试可能无法准确捕捉该语言变体的语言和文化细微差别。
AI.method: 在训练的中期和后期阶段使用更多高质量的欧洲葡萄牙语数据来训练AMALIA模型，并创建了一套专门的pt-PT基准测试套件，包括翻译的标准任务和四个针对pt-PT生成、语言能力及pt-PT/pt-BR偏见的新数据集。
AI.result: AMALIA在翻译的基准测试上与强基线模型表现相当，同时在pt-PT特定评估中性能显著提升，支持了针对欧洲葡萄牙语的定向训练和本地基准测试的重要性。

title: JRM: Joint Reconstruction Model for Multiple Objects without Alignment
summary: Object-centric reconstruction seeks to recover the 3D structure of a scene through composition of independent objects. While this independence can simplify modeling, it discards strong signals that could improve reconstruction, notably repetition where the same object model is seen multiple times in a scene, or across scans. We propose the Joint Reconstruction Model (JRM) to leverage repetition by framing object reconstruction as one of personalized generation: multiple observations share a common subject that should be consistent for all observations, while still adhering to the specific pose and state from each. Prior methods in this direction rely on explicit matching and rigid alignment across observations, making them sensitive to errors and difficult to extend to non-rigid transformations. In contrast, JRM is a 3D flow-matching generative model that implicitly aggregates unaligned observations in its latent space, learning to produce consistent and faithful reconstructions in a data-driven manner without explicit constraints. Evaluations on synthetic and real-world data show that JRM's implicit aggregation removes the need for explicit alignment, improves robustness to incorrect associations, and naturally handles non-rigid changes such as articulation. Overall, JRM outperforms both independent and alignment-based baselines in reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: JRM通过隐式聚合未对齐的观测数据，利用重复性改进物体中心重建，无需显式匹配和对齐，能处理非刚性变化
AI.motivation: 现有物体中心重建方法忽略了场景中物体重复性这一重要信号，而显式匹配和对齐方法对误差敏感且难以扩展到非刚性变换
AI.method: 提出联合重建模型(JRM)，基于3D流匹配生成模型，在潜在空间中隐式聚合未对齐的观测数据，通过个性化生成框架实现一致重建
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据上评估显示，JRM无需显式对齐，对错误关联更鲁棒，能自然处理关节等非刚性变化，重建质量优于独立和基于对齐的基线方法
AI.conclusion: JRM通过隐式聚合重复观测数据，有效提升了物体重建的一致性和准确性，为利用场景重复性提供了数据驱动的新方法

title: MemCam: Memory-Augmented Camera Control for Consistent Video Generation
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted by IJCNN 2026
summary: Interactive video generation has significant potential for scene simulation and video creation. However, existing methods often struggle with maintaining scene consistency during long video generation under dynamic camera control due to limited contextual information. To address this challenge, we propose MemCam, a memory-augmented interactive video generation approach that treats previously generated frames as external memory and leverages them as contextual conditioning to achieve controllable camera viewpoints with high scene consistency. To enable longer and more relevant context, we design a context compression module that encodes memory frames into compact representations and employs co-visibility-based selection to dynamically retrieve the most relevant historical frames, thereby reducing computational overhead while enriching contextual information. Experiments on interactive video generation tasks show that MemCam significantly outperforms existing baseline methods as well as open-source state-of-the-art approaches in terms of scene consistency, particularly in long video scenarios with large camera rotations.

AI.tldr: MemCam：一种基于记忆增强的交互式视频生成方法，通过将先前生成的帧作为外部记忆，利用上下文压缩和共可见性选择机制，在动态相机控制下实现长视频的高场景一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频生成方法在动态相机控制下生成长视频时，由于上下文信息有限，难以保持场景一致性。需要一种能够有效利用历史帧信息来增强场景一致性的方法。
AI.method: 提出MemCam方法：1）将先前生成的帧作为外部记忆；2）设计上下文压缩模块将记忆帧编码为紧凑表示；3）采用基于共可见性的选择机制动态检索最相关的历史帧；4）利用这些记忆作为上下文条件实现可控相机视角。
AI.result: 在交互式视频生成任务上的实验表明，MemCam在场景一致性方面显著优于现有基线方法和开源SOTA方法，特别是在具有大相机旋转的长视频场景中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: MemCam通过记忆增强机制有效解决了动态相机控制下长视频生成的场景一致性问题，为交互式视频生成提供了新的解决方案。

title: FAST3DIS: Feed-forward Anchored Scene Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation
summary: While recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction models provide a strong geometric foundation for scene understanding, extending them to 3D instance segmentation typically relies on a disjointed "lift-and-cluster" paradigm. Grouping dense pixel-wise embeddings via non-differentiable clustering scales poorly with the number of views and disconnects representation learning from the final segmentation objective. In this paper, we present a Feed-forward Anchored Scene Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation (FAST3DIS), an end-to-end approach that effectively bypasses post-hoc clustering. We introduce a 3D-anchored, query-based Transformer architecture built upon a foundational depth backbone, adapted efficiently to learn instance-specific semantics while retaining its zero-shot geometric priors. We formulate a learned 3D anchor generator coupled with an anchor-sampling cross-attention mechanism for view-consistent 3D instance segmentation. By projecting 3D object queries directly into multi-view feature maps, our method samples context efficiently. Furthermore, we introduce a dual-level regularization strategy, that couples multi-view contrastive learning with a dynamically scheduled spatial overlap penalty to explicitly prevent query collisions and ensure precise instance boundaries. Experiments on complex indoor 3D datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive segmentation accuracy with significantly improved memory scalability and inference speed over state-of-the-art clustering-based methods.

AI.tldr: FAST3DIS：一种端到端的3D实例分割方法，通过基于查询的Transformer架构绕过传统聚类方法，实现高效、可扩展的3D实例分割。
AI.motivation: 现有3D重建模型通常采用"提升-聚类"范式进行实例分割，这种方法存在几个问题：1）非可微聚类方法难以扩展；2）表示学习与最终分割目标脱节；3）随着视图数量增加，计算复杂度急剧上升。
AI.method: 提出FAST3DIS方法，包括：1）基于深度基础模型的3D锚定查询Transformer架构；2）学习的3D锚点生成器与锚点采样交叉注意力机制；3）将3D对象查询直接投影到多视图特征图进行高效上下文采样；4）双级正则化策略，结合多视图对比学习和动态调度的空间重叠惩罚。
AI.result: 在复杂室内3D数据集上的实验表明，该方法在分割准确性方面与最先进的基于聚类的方法相当，同时在内存可扩展性和推理速度方面有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: FAST3DIS提供了一种端到端的3D实例分割解决方案，有效绕过了传统聚类方法的局限性，在保持准确性的同时大幅提升了效率和可扩展性。

title: ALBA: A European Portuguese Benchmark for Evaluating Language and Linguistic Dimensions in Generative LLMs
comment: PROPOR 2026 - The 17th International Conference on Computational Processing of Portuguese
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) expand across multilingual domains, evaluating their performance in under-represented languages becomes increasingly important. European Portuguese (pt-PT) is particularly affected, as existing training data and benchmarks are mainly in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). To address this, we introduce ALBA, a linguistically grounded benchmark designed from the ground up to assess LLM proficiency in linguistic-related tasks in pt-PT across eight linguistic dimensions, including Language Variety, Culture-bound Semantics, Discourse Analysis, Word Plays, Syntax, Morphology, Lexicology, and Phonetics and Phonology. ALBA is manually constructed by language experts and paired with an LLM-as-a-judge framework for scalable evaluation of pt-PT generated language. Experiments on a diverse set of models reveal performance variability across linguistic dimensions, highlighting the need for comprehensive, variety-sensitive benchmarks that support further development of tools in pt-PT.

AI.tldr: ALBA是一个专门为欧洲葡萄牙语(pt-PT)设计的语言学基准测试，涵盖8个语言学维度，用于评估大语言模型在pt-PT上的表现，弥补了现有基准测试主要针对巴西葡萄牙语(pt-BR)的不足。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在多语言领域扩展，评估其在代表性不足语言中的性能变得日益重要。欧洲葡萄牙语(pt-PT)尤其受到影响，因为现有的训练数据和基准测试主要集中在巴西葡萄牙语(pt-BR)上。
AI.method: 研究人员构建了ALBA基准测试，这是一个从零开始设计的语言学基准，涵盖8个语言学维度：语言变体、文化绑定语义、话语分析、文字游戏、句法、形态学、词汇学和语音学。该基准由语言专家手动构建，并配有一个LLM-as-a-judge框架，用于对pt-PT生成语言进行可扩展评估。
AI.result: 在多样化模型上的实验揭示了不同语言学维度上的性能差异，表明需要全面的、变体敏感的基准测试来支持pt-PT工具的进一步发展。
AI.conclusion: ALBA基准测试填补了欧洲葡萄牙语评估的空白，强调了开发针对特定语言变体的全面基准测试的重要性，以支持大语言模型在代表性不足语言中的进一步发展。

title: Neighbor-Aware Localized Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure in text-to-image diffusion models seeks to remove undesired concepts while preserving overall generative capability. Localized erasure methods aim to restrict edits to the spatial region occupied by the target concept. However, we observe that suppressing a concept can unintentionally weaken semantically related neighbor concepts, reducing fidelity in fine-grained domains. We propose Neighbor-Aware Localized Concept Erasure (NLCE), a training-free framework designed to better preserve neighboring concepts while removing target concepts. It operates in three stages: (1) a spectrally-weighted embedding modulation that attenuates target concept directions while stabilizing neighbor concept representations, (2) an attention-guided spatial gate that identifies regions exhibiting residual concept activation, and (3) a spatially-gated hard erasure that eliminates remaining traces only where necessary. This neighbor-aware pipeline enables localized concept removal while maintaining the surrounding concept neighborhood structure. Experiments on fine-grained datasets (Oxford Flowers, Stanford Dogs) show that our method effectively removes target concepts while better preserving closely related categories. Additional results on celebrity identity, explicit content and artistic style demonstrate robustness and generalization to broader erasure scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NLCE框架，用于文本到图像扩散模型中的概念擦除，在局部擦除目标概念时更好地保留语义相关的邻近概念。
AI.motivation: 现有局部概念擦除方法在抑制目标概念时，会无意中削弱语义相关的邻近概念，降低细粒度领域的生成保真度。
AI.method: 提出三阶段训练免费框架：1) 频谱加权嵌入调制，衰减目标概念方向同时稳定邻近概念表示；2) 注意力引导的空间门，识别残留概念激活区域；3) 空间门控硬擦除，仅在必要时消除剩余痕迹。
AI.result: 在细粒度数据集（牛津花卉、斯坦福犬类）上实验表明，该方法能有效移除目标概念，同时更好地保留密切相关的类别。在名人身份、显式内容和艺术风格等场景中也展示了鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: NLCE框架实现了局部概念移除，同时保持了周围概念邻域结构，为文本到图像扩散模型中的概念擦除提供了更精细的解决方案。

title: How Open Must Language Models be to Enable Reliable Scientific Inference?
summary: How does the extent to which a model is open or closed impact the scientific inferences that can be drawn from research that involves it? In this paper, we analyze how restrictions on information about model construction and deployment threaten reliable inference. We argue that current closed models are generally ill-suited for scientific purposes, with some notable exceptions, and discuss ways in which the issues they present to reliable inference can be resolved or mitigated. We recommend that when models are used in research, potential threats to inference should be systematically identified along with the steps taken to mitigate them, and that specific justifications for model selection should be provided.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了模型开放与封闭程度如何影响科学研究的推断可靠性，指出当前封闭模型通常不适合科学研究，并提出了缓解这些问题的建议。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探讨模型开放程度对科学研究推断可靠性的影响。随着AI模型在科学研究中的应用日益广泛，模型信息的限制（如构建和部署细节的保密）可能威胁到科学推断的有效性，需要系统分析这一问题。
AI.method: 论文采用理论分析方法，系统分析了封闭模型对科学推断的威胁，识别了当前封闭模型在科学研究中的局限性，并提出了相应的解决方案和缓解措施。
AI.result: 研究发现当前封闭模型通常不适合科学研究（除少数例外情况），模型信息的限制会威胁可靠推断。论文提出了系统识别推断威胁、采取缓解措施的具体方法，并强调了模型选择需要提供具体理由。
AI.conclusion: 结论是当模型用于研究时，应系统识别潜在推断威胁并采取缓解措施，为模型选择提供具体理由。封闭模型通常不适合科学研究，需要建立相应的评估和选择框架来确保科学推断的可靠性。

title: Towards GUI Agents: Vision-Language Diffusion Models for GUI Grounding
summary: Autoregressive (AR) vision-language models (VLMs) have long dominated multimodal understanding, reasoning, and graphical user interface (GUI) grounding. Recently, discrete diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) have shown strong performance in multimodal reasoning, offering bidirectional attention, parallel token generation, and iterative refinement. However, their potential for GUI grounding remains unexplored. In this work, we evaluate whether discrete DVLMs can serve as a viable alternative to AR models for GUI grounding. We adapt LLaDA-V for single-turn action and bounding-box prediction, framing the task as text generation from multimodal input. To better capture the hierarchical structure of bounding-box geometry, we propose a hybrid masking schedule that combines linear and deterministic masking, improving grounding accuracy by up to 6.1 points in Step Success Rate (SSR) over the GUI-adapted LLaDA-V trained with linear masking. Evaluations on four datasets spanning web, desktop, and mobile interfaces show that the adapted diffusion model with hybrid masking consistently outperforms the linear-masked variant and performs competitively with autoregressive counterparts despite limited pretraining. Systematic ablations reveal that increasing diffusion steps, generation length, and block length improves accuracy but also increases latency, with accuracy plateauing beyond a certain number of diffusion steps. Expanding the training data with diverse GUI domains further reduces latency by about 1.3 seconds and improves grounding accuracy by an average of 20 points across benchmarks. These results demonstrate that discrete DVLMs are a promising modeling framework for GUI grounding and represent an important step toward diffusion-based GUI agents.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索离散扩散视觉语言模型在GUI grounding任务中的潜力，提出混合掩码策略提升性能，在多个数据集上表现与自回归模型相当。
AI.motivation: 自回归视觉语言模型长期主导多模态理解和GUI grounding任务，而离散扩散模型在多模态推理中表现出色但尚未在GUI grounding中得到验证。本研究旨在探索离散扩散模型是否可以作为自回归模型的有效替代方案。
AI.method: 将LLaDA-V适配于单轮动作和边界框预测任务，将任务构建为从多模态输入生成文本。提出混合掩码策略（结合线性和确定性掩码）以更好地捕捉边界框几何的层次结构。在四个数据集上进行评估，并进行系统消融实验。
AI.result: 混合掩码策略比线性掩码变体在Step Success Rate上提升6.1个百分点。尽管预训练有限，但适配的扩散模型在性能上与自回归模型相当。增加扩散步数、生成长度和块长度可提升准确性但增加延迟。扩展训练数据可减少约1.3秒延迟并在各基准测试中平均提升20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 离散扩散视觉语言模型是GUI grounding的有前景的建模框架，代表了向基于扩散的GUI代理发展的重要一步。

title: Development of a European Union Time-Indexed Reference Dataset for Assessing the Performance of Signal Detection Methods in Pharmacovigilance using a Large Language Model
summary: Background: The identification of optimal signal detection methods is hindered by the lack of reliable reference datasets. Existing datasets do not capture when adverse events (AEs) are officially recognized by regulatory authorities, preventing restriction of analyses to pre-confirmation periods and limiting evaluation of early detection performance. This study addresses this gap by developing a time-indexed reference dataset for the European Union (EU), incorporating the timing of AE inclusion in product labels along with regulatory metadata. Methods: Current and historical Summaries of Product Characteristics (SmPCs) for all centrally authorized products (n=1,513) were retrieved from the EU Union Register of Medicinal Products (data lock: 15 December 2025). Section 4.8 was extracted and processed using DeepSeek V3 to identify AEs. Regulatory metadata, including labelling changes, were programmatically extracted. Time indexing was based on the date of AE inclusion in the SmPC. Results: The database includes 17,763 SmPC versions spanning 1995-2025, comprising 125,026 drug-AE associations. The time-indexed reference dataset, restricted to active products, included 1,479 medicinal products and 110,823 drug-AE associations. Most AEs were identified pre-marketing (74.5%) versus post-marketing (25.5%). Safety updates peaked around 2012. Gastrointestinal, skin, and nervous system disorders were the most represented System Organ Classes. Drugs had a median of 48 AEs across 14 SOCs. Conclusions: The proposed dataset addresses a critical gap in pharmacovigilance by incorporating temporal information on AE recognition for the EU, supporting more accurate assessment of signal detection performance and facilitating methodological comparisons across analytical approaches.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个时间索引的欧盟药物不良反应参考数据集，包含药物标签中不良反应的纳入时间信息，用于更准确地评估信号检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集缺乏可靠的参考标准，无法捕捉不良反应被监管机构正式确认的时间，限制了早期检测性能的评估。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 从欧盟药品注册中心检索所有集中授权产品的当前和历史产品特性摘要，使用DeepSeek V3提取第4.8节中的不良反应，程序化提取监管元数据，基于不良反应纳入产品特性摘要的日期进行时间索引。
AI.result: 数据库包含1995-2025年间的17,763个产品特性摘要版本，涵盖125,026个药物-不良反应关联。时间索引参考数据集包含1,479个活性产品和110,823个药物-不良反应关联。74.5%的不良反应在上市前识别，25.5%在上市后识别。安全更新在2012年左右达到高峰。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集通过纳入欧盟不良反应识别的时间信息，填补了药物警戒的关键空白，支持更准确地评估信号检测性能，并促进不同分析方法之间的方法学比较。

title: When Perplexity Lies: Generation-Focused Distillation of Hybrid Sequence Models
summary:
Converting a pretrained Transformer into a more efficient hybrid model through distillation offers a promising approach to reducing inference costs. However, achieving high-quality generation in distilled models requires careful joint design of both the student architecture and the distillation process. Many prior distillation works evaluate downstream multiple-choice benchmarks by ranking candidate answers with log-likelihood rather than requiring autoregressive generation, which can obscure important differences in model quality. For example, we show that a 7B parameter distilled model that nearly matches its teacher to within 0.2\,pp under log-likelihood scoring actually falls behind by 20.8\,pp when the model must generate answers autoregressively.
  We propose a Hybrid Kimi Delta Attention (Hybrid-KDA) architecture paired with GenDistill, a multi-stage distillation pipeline, and use generation-based evaluation throughout to guide design decisions. Applying this approach to Qwen3-0.6B, we systematically ablate six design axes: training objective, loss masking, training duration, dataset selection, parameter freezing, and architecture choice. We find that log-likelihood-based evaluation consistently underestimates the gap between teacher and student, and can in some cases reverse the ranking of design choices, meaning that conclusions drawn from perplexity-only evaluation may be misleading. Among the factors we study, dataset selection, completion-only masking, and freezing attention layers during post-training have the largest impact on generation quality.
  Our best Hybrid-KDA model retains 86--90\% of teacher accuracy on knowledge benchmarks while reducing KV cache memory by up to 75\% and improving time-to-first-token by 2--4$\times$ at 128K-token contexts.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种混合KDA架构和GenDistill蒸馏流程，通过生成式评估指导设计，发现基于对数似然的评估会低估师生模型差距，甚至颠倒设计选择排名。
AI.motivation: 现有蒸馏方法通常使用对数似然评分评估下游任务，这会掩盖模型在自回归生成质量上的重要差异。需要一种能准确评估生成质量的蒸馏方法，以指导学生架构和蒸馏过程的联合设计。
AI.method: 提出Hybrid-KDA架构和GenDistill多阶段蒸馏流程，系统消融六个设计维度：训练目标、损失掩码、训练时长、数据集选择、参数冻结和架构选择，全程使用生成式评估指导设计决策。
AI.result: 发现对数似然评估会系统性低估师生模型差距，有时甚至颠倒设计选择排名。数据集选择、仅完成掩码和注意力层冻结对生成质量影响最大。最佳模型在知识基准上保留86-90%教师准确率，同时将KV缓存内存减少75%，在128K上下文下首词延迟改善2-4倍。
AI.conclusion: 生成式评估对于蒸馏模型设计至关重要，对数似然评估可能产生误导性结论。提出的Hybrid-KDA架构和GenDistill流程能有效平衡模型效率和生成质量，为高效混合模型蒸馏提供了系统方法。

title: MemBoost: A Memory-Boosted Framework for Cost-Aware LLM Inference
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) deliver strong performance but incur high inference cost in real-world services, especially under workloads with repeated or near-duplicate queries across users and sessions. In this work, we propose MemBoost, a memory-boosted LLM serving framework that enables a lightweight model to reuse previously generated answers and retrieve relevant supporting information for cheap inference, while selectively escalating difficult or uncertain queries to a stronger model. Unlike standard retrieval-augmented generation, which primarily grounds a single response, MemBoost is designed for interactive settings by supporting answer reuse, continual memory growth, and cost-aware routing. Experiments across multiple models under simulated workloads show that MemBoost substantially reduces expensive large-model invocations and overall inference cost, while maintaining high answer quality comparable to the strong model baseline.

AI.tldr: MemBoost是一个内存增强的LLM服务框架，通过重用先前生成的答案和检索相关信息来降低推理成本，同时将困难查询路由到更强模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然性能强大，但在实际服务中推理成本高昂，特别是在用户和会话中存在重复或近似重复查询的工作负载下。
AI.method: 提出MemBoost框架，让轻量级模型能够重用先前生成的答案并检索相关信息进行廉价推理，同时将困难或不确定的查询选择性地升级到更强的模型。与标准检索增强生成不同，MemBoost专为交互式场景设计，支持答案重用、持续内存增长和成本感知路由。
AI.result: 在模拟工作负载下的多个模型实验中，MemBoost显著减少了昂贵的大型模型调用和总体推理成本，同时保持了与强模型基线相当的高答案质量。
AI.conclusion: MemBoost是一个有效的LLM服务框架，能够在保持高质量的同时显著降低推理成本，特别适用于具有重复查询模式的实际服务场景。

title: ARTA: Adaptive Mixed-Resolution Token Allocation for Efficient Dense Feature Extraction
summary: We present ARTA, a mixed-resolution coarse-to-fine vision transformer for efficient dense feature extraction. Unlike models that begin with dense high-resolution (fine) tokens, ARTA starts with low-resolution (coarse) tokens and uses a lightweight allocator to predict which regions require more fine tokens. The allocator iteratively predicts a semantic (class) boundary score and allocates additional tokens to patches above a low threshold, concentrating token density near boundaries while maintaining high sensitivity to weak boundary evidence. This targeted allocation encourages tokens to represent a single semantic class rather than a mixture of classes. Mixed-resolution attention enables interaction between coarse and fine tokens, focusing computation on semantically complex areas while avoiding redundant processing in homogeneous regions. Experiments demonstrate that ARTA achieves state-of-the-art results on ADE20K and COCO-Stuff with substantially fewer FLOPs, and delivers competitive performance on Cityscapes at markedly lower compute. For example, ARTA-Base attains 54.6 mIoU on ADE20K in the ~100M-parameter class while using fewer FLOPs and less memory than comparable backbones.

AI.tldr: ARTA是一种混合分辨率粗到细视觉Transformer，通过轻量级分配器动态分配细粒度token到语义边界区域，在保持高性能的同时大幅减少计算量。
AI.motivation: 传统密集高分辨率token提取方法计算冗余，特别是在语义同质区域。需要一种更高效的方法，能够将计算资源集中在语义复杂的边界区域，同时减少在简单区域的冗余处理。
AI.method: ARTA从低分辨率（粗）token开始，使用轻量级分配器迭代预测语义边界分数，将额外细粒度token分配到边界阈值以上的区域。采用混合分辨率注意力机制，允许粗粒度和细粒度token交互，将计算集中在语义复杂区域。
AI.result: 在ADE20K和COCO-Stuff上达到最先进结果，计算量大幅减少；在Cityscapes上以显著更低的计算成本获得竞争性性能。ARTA-Base在ADE20K上达到54.6 mIoU，参数量约1亿，比可比骨干网络使用更少的FLOPs和内存。
AI.conclusion: ARTA通过动态token分配和混合分辨率注意力，实现了高效密集特征提取，在语义分割任务中取得了计算效率和性能的良好平衡，为视觉Transformer的高效应用提供了新思路。

title: EnTaCs: Analyzing the Relationship Between Sentiment and Language Choice in English-Tamil Code-Switching
summary: This paper investigates the relationship between utterance sentiment and language choice in English-Tamil code-switched text, using methods from machine learning and statistical modelling. We apply a fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa model for token-level language identification on 35,650 romanized YouTube comments from the DravidianCodeMix dataset, producing per-utterance measurements of English proportion and language switch frequency. Linear regression analysis reveals that positive utterances exhibit significantly greater English proportion (34.3%) than negative utterances (24.8%), and mixed-sentiment utterances show the highest language switch frequency when controlling for utterance length. These findings support the hypothesis that emotional content demonstrably influences language choice in multilingual code-switching settings, due to socio-linguistic associations of prestige and identity with embedded and matrix languages.

AI.tldr: 研究发现英语-泰米尔语码转换文本中，积极情绪的话语英语比例更高（34.3% vs 24.8%），混合情绪的话语语言切换频率最高，表明情感内容显著影响多语言环境中的语言选择。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索在多语言码转换环境中，话语情感与语言选择之间的关系，验证情感内容是否会影响说话者的语言选择，特别是英语和泰米尔语之间的转换模式。
AI.method: 使用机器学习与统计建模方法，对DravidianCodeMix数据集中35,650条罗马化的YouTube评论进行细调XLM-RoBERTa模型的token级语言识别，计算每句话的英语比例和语言切换频率，然后进行线性回归分析。
AI.result: 线性回归分析显示：积极情绪的话语英语比例显著高于消极情绪话语（34.3% vs 24.8%）；混合情绪的话语在控制话语长度后表现出最高的语言切换频率；情感内容确实显著影响多语言码转换环境中的语言选择。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论支持情感内容显著影响多语言码转换环境中语言选择的假设，这种影响源于嵌入语言和基质语言在社会语言学上的声望和身份认同关联。

title: Weight Tying Biases Token Embeddings Towards the Output Space
summary: Weight tying, i.e. sharing parameters between input and output embedding matrices, is common practice in language model design, yet its impact on the learned embedding space remains poorly understood. In this paper, we show that tied embedding matrices align more closely with output (unembedding) matrices than with input embeddings of comparable untied models, indicating that the shared matrix is shaped primarily for output prediction rather than input representation. This unembedding bias arises because output gradients dominate early in training. Using tuned lens analysis, we show this negatively affects early-layer computations, which contribute less effectively to the residual stream. Scaling input gradients during training reduces this bias, providing causal evidence for the role of gradient imbalance. This is mechanistic evidence that weight tying optimizes the embedding matrix for output prediction, compromising its role in input representation. These results help explain why weight tying can harm performance at scale and have implications for training smaller LLMs, where the embedding matrix contributes substantially to total parameter count.

AI.tldr: 权重共享（输入输出嵌入矩阵共享参数）使嵌入矩阵更偏向输出预测而非输入表示，这源于训练早期输出梯度的主导作用，可能损害模型性能
AI.motivation: 研究权重共享对语言模型嵌入空间学习的影响，理解为什么这种常见做法可能在大规模模型中损害性能
AI.method: 比较共享权重模型与不共享权重模型的嵌入矩阵对齐程度，使用tuned lens分析早期层计算，通过缩放输入梯度来验证梯度不平衡的作用
AI.result: 共享权重矩阵更接近输出（解嵌入）矩阵而非输入嵌入矩阵，输出梯度在训练早期占主导地位，这损害了早期层对残差流的贡献
AI.conclusion: 权重共享使嵌入矩阵主要优化输出预测，损害了其输入表示功能，这解释了为什么在大规模模型中权重共享可能损害性能，对参数有限的小型LLM训练有重要影响

title: PhysVid: Physics Aware Local Conditioning for Generative Video Models
summary: Generative video models achieve high visual fidelity but often violate basic physical principles, limiting reliability in real-world settings. Prior attempts to inject physics rely on conditioning: frame-level signals are domain-specific and short-horizon, while global text prompts are coarse and noisy, missing fine-grained dynamics. We present PhysVid, a physics-aware local conditioning scheme that operates over temporally contiguous chunks of frames. Each chunk is annotated with physics-grounded descriptions of states, interactions, and constraints, which are fused with the global prompt via chunk-aware cross-attention during training. At inference, we introduce negative physics prompts (descriptions of locally relevant law violations) to steer generation away from implausible trajectories. On VideoPhy, PhysVid improves physical commonsense scores by $\approx 33\%$ over baseline video generators, and by up to $\approx 8\%$ on VideoPhy2. These results show that local, physics-aware guidance substantially increases physical plausibility in generative video and marks a step toward physics-grounded video models.

AI.tldr: PhysVid提出了一种物理感知的视频生成方法，通过局部物理条件化机制提升生成视频的物理合理性
AI.motivation: 现有生成视频模型虽然视觉保真度高，但经常违反基本物理原理，限制了在真实世界应用中的可靠性。先前基于条件化的物理注入方法存在局限性：帧级信号过于领域特定且短期，全局文本提示则过于粗糙且噪声大，无法捕捉细粒度动态。
AI.method: PhysVid采用物理感知的局部条件化方案，在时间连续的视频块上操作。每个视频块用物理基础的状态、交互和约束描述进行标注，通过块感知的交叉注意力机制与全局提示融合。在推理时引入负物理提示（描述局部相关物理定律违反）来引导生成远离不合理的轨迹。
AI.result: 在VideoPhy基准上，PhysVid将物理常识得分提高了约33%，在VideoPhy2上提高了约8%。这些结果表明局部物理感知指导显著提升了生成视频的物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 局部物理感知指导显著提高了生成视频的物理合理性，标志着向物理基础视频模型迈出了一步。

title: Knowledge is Power: Advancing Few-shot Action Recognition with Multimodal Semantics from MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have propelled the field of few-shot action recognition (FSAR). However, preliminary explorations in this area primarily focus on generating captions to form a suboptimal feature->caption->feature pipeline and adopt metric learning solely within the visual space. In this paper, we propose FSAR-LLaVA, the first end-to-end method to leverage MLLMs (such as Video-LLaVA) as a multimodal knowledge base for directly enhancing FSAR. First, at the feature level, we leverage the MLLM's multimodal decoder to extract spatiotemporally and semantically enriched representations, which are then decoupled and enhanced by our Multimodal Feature-Enhanced Module into distinct visual and textual features that fully exploit their semantic knowledge for FSAR. Next, we leverage the versatility of MLLMs to craft input prompts that flexibly adapt to diverse scenarios, and use their aligned outputs to drive our designed Composite Task-Oriented Prototype Construction, effectively bridging the distribution gap between meta-train and meta-test sets. Finally, to enable multimodal features to guide metric learning jointly, we introduce a training-free Multimodal Prototype Matching Metric that adaptively selects the most decisive cues and efficiently leverages the decoupled feature representations produced by MLLMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance across various tasks with minimal trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: FSAR-LLaVA：首个端到端利用多模态大语言模型直接增强少样本动作识别的方法，通过多模态特征增强、复合任务导向原型构建和多模态原型匹配度量实现性能提升
AI.motivation: 现有少样本动作识别方法主要依赖生成字幕形成次优的特征->字幕->特征流程，且仅在视觉空间进行度量学习。需要更直接利用多模态大语言模型的丰富知识来提升性能
AI.method: 1) 多模态特征增强模块：利用MLLM的多模态解码器提取时空和语义增强表示，解耦为视觉和文本特征；2) 复合任务导向原型构建：利用MLLM的灵活性设计输入提示，对齐输出以弥合元训练和元测试集分布差距；3) 训练免费的多模态原型匹配度量：自适应选择最具决定性的线索，高效利用MLLM产生的解耦特征表示
AI.result: 在多种任务上表现出优越性能，且仅需极少的可训练参数
AI.conclusion: FSAR-LLaVA首次实现了端到端利用多模态大语言模型直接增强少样本动作识别，通过多模态特征提取、原型构建和匹配度量的创新设计，显著提升了模型性能

title: Face2Parts: Exploring Coarse-to-Fine Inter-Regional Facial Dependencies for Generalized Deepfake Detection
summary: Multimedia data, particularly images and videos, is integral to various applications, including surveillance, visual interaction, biometrics, evidence gathering, and advertising. However, amateur or skilled counterfeiters can simulate them to create deepfakes, often for slanderous motives. To address this challenge, several forensic methods have been developed to ensure the authenticity of the content. The effectiveness of these methods depends on their focus, with challenges arising from the diverse nature of manipulations. In this article, we analyze existing forensic methods and observe that each method has unique strengths in detecting deepfake traces by focusing on specific facial regions, such as the frame, face, lips, eyes, or nose. Considering these insights, we propose a novel hybrid approach called Face2Parts based on hierarchical feature representation ($HFR$) that takes advantage of coarse-to-fine information to improve deepfake detection. The proposed method involves extracting features from the frame, face, and key facial regions (i.e., lips, eyes, and nose) separately to explore the coarse-to-fine relationships. This approach enables us to capture inter-dependencies among facial regions using a channel-attention mechanism and deep triplet learning. We evaluated the proposed method on benchmark deepfake datasets in both intra-, inter-dataset, and inter-manipulation settings. The proposed method achieves an average AUC of 98.42\% on FF++, 79.80\% on CDF1, 85.34\% on CDF2, 89.41\% on DFD, 84.07\% on DFDC, 95.62\% on DTIM, 80.76\% on PDD, and 100\% on WLDR, respectively. The results demonstrate that our approach generalizes effectively and achieves promising performance to outperform the existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Face2Parts的深度伪造检测方法，通过分层特征表示（HFR）利用从粗到细的信息，分别提取帧、面部及关键面部区域（嘴唇、眼睛、鼻子）的特征，并结合通道注意力机制和深度三元组学习来捕获区域间的相互依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 多媒体数据（特别是图像和视频）在监控、视觉交互、生物识别、证据收集和广告等应用中至关重要，但业余或专业的伪造者可以模拟它们来创建深度伪造内容，通常出于诽谤动机。现有取证方法各有侧重，但面临操纵多样性的挑战，每种方法在检测特定面部区域的深度伪造痕迹方面有独特优势。
AI.method: 提出Face2Parts方法，基于分层特征表示（HFR），采用从粗到细的信息提取策略：分别从帧、面部以及关键面部区域（嘴唇、眼睛、鼻子）提取特征，探索粗到细的关系。使用通道注意力机制捕获面部区域间的相互依赖关系，并结合深度三元组学习。
AI.result: 在多个基准深度伪造数据集上评估，在FF++上平均AUC为98.42%，CDF1为79.80%，CDF2为85.34%，DFD为89.41%，DFDC为84.07%，DTIM为95.62%，PDD为80.76%，WLDR为100%。结果表明该方法能有效泛化并优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Face2Parts方法通过分层特征表示和从粗到细的信息提取，结合通道注意力机制和深度三元组学习，能够有效检测深度伪造内容，在多个数据集上表现出优越性能，具有良好的泛化能力。

title: Preference-Aligned LoRA Merging: Preserving Subspace Coverage and Addressing Directional Anisotropy
summary: Merging multiple Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules is promising for constructing general-purpose systems, yet challenging because LoRA update directions span different subspaces and contribute unevenly. When merged naively, such mismatches can weaken the directions most critical to certain task losses while overemphasizing relatively less important ones, ultimately reducing the model's ability to represent all tasks faithfully. We revisit this problem through two perspectives: subspace coverage, which captures how broadly LoRA directions cover diverse representational directions, and anisotropy, which reflects the imbalance of influence across those directions. We propose TARA-Merging (Task-Rank Anisotropy Alignment), which aligns merging weights using a preference-weighted cross-entropy pseudo-loss while preserving task-relevant LoRA subspaces. This ensures broad subspace coverage and mitigates anisotropy via direction-wise reweighting. Across eight vision and six NLI benchmarks, TARA-Merging consistently outperforms vanilla and LoRA-aware baselines, demonstrating strong robustness and generalization, and highlighting the importance of addressing both subspace coverage and anisotropy in LoRA merging.

AI.tldr: TARA-Merging是一种新的LoRA模块合并方法，通过子空间覆盖度和各向异性对齐来解决多任务LoRA合并中的方向冲突问题，在多个视觉和NLI基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 多个LoRA模块合并时，由于更新方向分布在不同的子空间且贡献不均，简单的合并会削弱对某些任务损失最关键的方向，同时过度强调相对不重要的方向，从而降低模型忠实表示所有任务的能力。
AI.method: 提出TARA-Merging（任务-秩各向异性对齐）方法，通过偏好加权的交叉熵伪损失来对齐合并权重，同时保留任务相关的LoRA子空间。该方法确保广泛的子空间覆盖，并通过方向重新加权来缓解各向异性问题。
AI.result: 在八个视觉基准和六个自然语言推理基准测试中，TARA-Merging始终优于普通方法和LoRA感知基线，表现出强大的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TARA-Merging方法有效解决了LoRA合并中的子空间覆盖和各向异性问题，强调了在LoRA合并中同时处理这两个方面的重要性。

title: Rethinking Token Pruning for Historical Screenshots in GUI Visual Agents: Semantic, Spatial, and Temporal Perspectives
summary: In recent years, GUI visual agents built upon Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in navigation tasks. However, high-resolution GUI screenshots produce a large number of visual tokens, making the direct preservation of complete historical information computationally expensive. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on token pruning for historical screenshots in GUI scenarios and distill three practical insights that are crucial for designing effective pruning strategies. First, we observe that GUI screenshots exhibit a distinctive foreground-background semantic composition. To probe this property, we apply a simple edge-based separation to partition screenshots into foreground and background regions. Surprisingly, we find that, contrary to the common assumption that background areas have little semantic value, they effectively capture interface-state transitions, thereby providing auxiliary cues for GUI reasoning. Second, compared with carefully designed pruning strategies, random pruning possesses an inherent advantage in preserving spatial structure, enabling better performance under the same computational budget. Finally, we observe that GUI Agents exhibit a recency effect similar to human cognition: by allocating larger token budgets to more recent screenshots and heavily compressing distant ones, we can significantly reduce computational cost while maintaining nearly unchanged performance. These findings offer new insights and practical guidance for the design of efficient GUI visual agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了GUI视觉代理中历史截图的高效token剪枝策略，发现GUI截图具有前景-背景语义结构，随机剪枝在保持空间结构方面优于精心设计的策略，且GUI代理存在类似人类认知的近期效应。
AI.motivation: 基于多模态大语言模型的GUI视觉代理在导航任务中表现出强大潜力，但高分辨率GUI截图产生大量视觉token，完整保留历史信息计算成本过高。需要研究如何在GUI场景中对历史截图进行有效的token剪枝。
AI.method: 通过实证研究探索GUI场景中历史截图的token剪枝策略。首先分析GUI截图的前景-背景语义组成，使用基于边缘的分割方法将截图分为前景和背景区域。比较不同剪枝策略的效果，包括随机剪枝和精心设计的策略。研究GUI代理的近期效应，通过为近期截图分配更多token预算、压缩较远截图来优化计算资源分配。
AI.result: 1. GUI截图具有独特的前景-背景语义组成，背景区域能有效捕捉界面状态转换，为GUI推理提供辅助线索；2. 随机剪枝相比精心设计的策略具有保持空间结构的固有优势，在相同计算预算下表现更好；3. GUI代理存在类似人类认知的近期效应，通过差异化分配token预算可显著降低计算成本而性能几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为高效GUI视觉代理的设计提供了新的见解和实用指导：应重视GUI截图的前景-背景语义结构，利用随机剪枝的优势，并考虑GUI代理的近期效应来优化token分配策略，从而在保持性能的同时显著降低计算成本。

title: Label-Free Cross-Task LoRA Merging with Null-Space Compression
summary: Model merging combines independently fine-tuned checkpoints without joint multi-task training. In the era of foundation-model, fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is prevalent, making LoRA merging a promising target. Existing approaches can work in homogeneous settings where all target tasks are classification but often fail when tasks span classification and regression. Approaches using entropy-based surrogates do not apply to regression and are costly for large language models due to long token sequences. We introduce Null-Space Compression (NSC) Merging, a label-free, output-agnostic method that sets merge weights from adapter geometry. Our key observation is that during LoRA finetuning the down-projection factor $A$ in $ΔW = BA$ compresses its null space, and the compression correlates with performance. NSC uses this as an optimization signal for merging that can generalize across classification, regression, and sequence generation. NSC achieves state-of-the-art performance across twenty heterogeneous vision tasks with balanced gains where prior methods overfit subsets of tasks. It also outperforms baselines on six NLI benchmarks and on vision-language evaluations for VQA and image captioning, demonstrating scalability and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出NSC合并方法，解决LoRA模型合并中分类和回归任务混合时的性能问题，通过适配器几何结构设置合并权重，实现跨任务类型的有效合并。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法主要适用于同质任务（如全部分类任务），但在处理分类和回归混合的异构任务时效果不佳。基于熵的代理方法不适用于回归任务，且对大型语言模型计算成本高。
AI.method: 提出零空间压缩(NSC)合并方法，这是一种无标签、输出无关的方法。核心观察是LoRA微调中下投影因子A会压缩其零空间，且压缩程度与性能相关。NSC利用这一几何特性作为优化信号来设置合并权重。
AI.result: NSC在20个异构视觉任务上达到最先进性能，在先前方法会过拟合部分任务的情况下实现平衡增益。在6个NLI基准测试以及VQA和图像描述的视觉语言评估中也优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: NSC合并方法能够有效处理分类、回归和序列生成等异构任务，展示了可扩展性和有效性，为LoRA模型合并提供了新的几何优化思路。

title: Mitigating the Reasoning Tax in Vision-Language Fine-Tuning with Input-Adaptive Depth Aggregation
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on visual instruction data often improves perceptual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs) while degrading reasoning performance, creating a persistent reasoning tax during post-training. We investigate whether this degradation is related to disrupted access to depth-wise representations, and find that even fixed cross-depth aggregation substantially restores reasoning, suggesting that preserved cross-depth access is an important missing factor in VLM fine-tuning. Building on this observation, we propose Input-Adaptive Depth Aggregation (IADA), a lightweight mechanism that makes cross-depth retrieval input-adaptive, modality-aware, and efficiently parameterized through a low-rank bottleneck. On Qwen3-VL-2B, IADA improves the average reasoning score by 9.5 points and the average perception score by $3.3$ points over LoRA-only fine-tuning with only 0.14M additional parameters, with the strongest gains appearing in parameter-efficient low-rank settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IADA方法解决视觉语言模型微调中的推理性能下降问题，通过输入自适应深度聚合机制恢复跨深度表示访问，在参数高效设置下显著提升推理和感知能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在视觉指令数据上进行监督微调时，通常会提升感知能力但降低推理性能，形成"推理税"。作者研究这种退化是否与跨深度表示访问的破坏有关。
AI.method: 提出输入自适应深度聚合(IADA)机制，通过低秩瓶颈实现输入自适应、模态感知的跨深度检索，参数高效且轻量级。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-2B模型上，IADA相比仅使用LoRA的微调，平均推理分数提升9.5分，平均感知分数提升3.3分，仅增加0.14M参数，在低秩参数高效设置下效果最显著。
AI.conclusion: 保持跨深度表示访问是视觉语言模型微调中重要的缺失因素，IADA机制能有效解决微调过程中的推理性能退化问题，实现推理和感知能力的同步提升。

title: Pioneering Perceptual Video Fluency Assessment: A Novel Task with Benchmark Dataset and Baseline
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures. Accepted by CVPR 2026 findings track
summary: Accurately estimating humans' subjective feedback on video fluency, e.g., motion consistency and frame continuity, is crucial for various applications like streaming and gaming. Yet, it has long been overlooked, as prior arts have focused on solving it in the video quality assessment (VQA) task, merely as a sub-dimension of overall quality. In this work, we conduct pilot experiments and reveal that current VQA predictions largely underrepresent fluency, thereby limiting their applicability. To this end, we pioneer Video Fluency Assessment (VFA) as a standalone perceptual task focused on the temporal dimension. To advance VFA research, 1) we construct a fluency-oriented dataset, FluVid, comprising 4,606 in-the-wild videos with balanced fluency distribution, featuring the first-ever scoring criteria and human study for VFA. 2) We develop a large-scale benchmark of 23 methods, the most comprehensive one thus far on FluVid, gathering insights for VFA-tailored model designs. 3) We propose a baseline model called FluNet, which deploys temporal permuted self-attention (T-PSA) to enrich input fluency information and enhance long-range inter-frame interactions. Our work not only achieves state-of-the-art performance but, more importantly, offers the community a roadmap to explore solutions for VFA.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次将视频流畅度评估(VFA)作为一个独立的感知任务提出，构建了首个流畅度数据集FluVid，开发了包含23种方法的基准，并提出了基于时序置换自注意力的FluNet模型，为VFA研究提供了路线图。
AI.motivation: 现有视频质量评估(VQA)方法主要关注整体质量，而忽略了视频流畅度（运动一致性和帧连续性）这一重要维度。研究发现当前VQA预测严重低估了流畅度的重要性，限制了其实际应用价值。
AI.method: 1) 构建FluVid数据集：包含4,606个真实世界视频，具有平衡的流畅度分布，首次为VFA制定了评分标准和人工标注研究；2) 建立包含23种方法的大规模基准；3) 提出FluNet基线模型，采用时序置换自注意力(T-PSA)来丰富输入流畅度信息并增强长距离帧间交互。
AI.result: FluNet在FluVid数据集上实现了最先进的性能表现。更重要的是，该研究为VFA领域提供了首个全面的数据集、基准测试和模型设计路线图。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将视频流畅度评估确立为独立的研究任务，通过构建数据集、基准测试和基线模型，为社区探索VFA解决方案提供了完整的研究框架和路线图，填补了现有视频评估领域的重要空白。

title: Reflect to Inform: Boosting Multimodal Reasoning via Information-Gain-Driven Verification
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong multimodal reasoning performance, yet we identify a recurring failure mode in long-form generation: as outputs grow longer, models progressively drift away from image evidence and fall back on textual priors, resulting in ungrounded reasoning and hallucinations. Interestingly, Based on attention analysis, we find that MLLMs have a latent capability for late-stage visual verification that is present but not consistently activated. Motivated by this observation, we propose Visual Re-Examination (VRE), a self-evolving training framework that enables MLLMs to autonomously perform visual introspection during reasoning without additional visual inputs. Rather than distilling visual capabilities from a stronger teacher, VRE promotes iterative self-improvement by leveraging the model itself to generate reflection traces, making visual information actionable through information gain. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that VRE consistently improves reasoning accuracy and perceptual reliability, while substantially reducing hallucinations, especially in long-chain settings. Code is available at https://github.com/Xiaobu-USTC/VRE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出视觉再检查（VRE）框架，解决多模态大语言模型在长文本生成中逐渐偏离图像证据、依赖文本先验导致幻觉的问题，通过自我演化的训练方法让模型在推理过程中自主进行视觉内省。
AI.motivation: 研究发现多模态大语言模型在长文本生成中存在一个常见失败模式：随着输出变长，模型逐渐偏离图像证据，转而依赖文本先验，导致推理不接地气和产生幻觉。有趣的是，通过注意力分析发现模型具有后期视觉验证的潜在能力，但未被持续激活。
AI.method: 提出视觉再检查（VRE）框架，这是一个自我演化的训练框架，使多模态大语言模型能够在推理过程中自主进行视觉内省，无需额外视觉输入。VRE不依赖从更强教师模型蒸馏视觉能力，而是通过让模型自身生成反思轨迹来促进迭代自我改进，通过信息增益使视觉信息可操作化。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准测试上的广泛实验表明，VRE能持续提高推理准确性和感知可靠性，同时显著减少幻觉，特别是在长链推理场景中。
AI.conclusion: VRE框架有效解决了多模态大语言模型在长文本生成中的视觉漂移问题，通过自我演化的视觉内省机制增强了模型的视觉接地能力和可靠性。

title: PAD-Hand: Physics-Aware Diffusion for Hand Motion Recovery
summary: Significant advancements made in reconstructing hands from images have delivered accurate single-frame estimates, yet they often lack physics consistency and provide no notion of how confidently the motion satisfies physics. In this paper, we propose a novel physics-aware conditional diffusion framework that refines noisy pose sequences into physically plausible hand motion while estimating the physics variance in motion estimates. Building on a MeshCNN-Transformer backbone, we formulate Euler-Lagrange dynamics for articulated hands. Unlike prior works that enforce zero residuals, we treat the resulting dynamic residuals as virtual observables to more effectively integrate physics. Through a last-layer Laplace approximation, our method produces per-joint, per-time variances that measure physics consistency and offers interpretable variance maps indicating where physical consistency weakens. Experiments on two well-known hand datasets show consistent gains over strong image-based initializations and competitive video-based methods. Qualitative results confirm that our variance estimations are aligned with the physical plausibility of the motion in image-based estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种物理感知的条件扩散框架，用于将噪声姿态序列细化为物理合理的手部运动，同时估计运动估计中的物理方差。
AI.motivation: 现有图像重建手部的方法虽然能提供准确的单帧估计，但缺乏物理一致性，且无法评估运动满足物理约束的置信度。
AI.method: 基于MeshCNN-Transformer骨干网络，构建了关节手的欧拉-拉格朗日动力学模型，将动态残差视为虚拟观测值而非强制为零，通过最后一层拉普拉斯近似生成每个关节、每个时间点的方差。
AI.result: 在两个知名手部数据集上的实验显示，相比基于图像的强初始化方法和竞争的视频方法都取得了持续改进，方差估计与图像估计中运动的物理合理性一致。
AI.conclusion: 提出的物理感知条件扩散框架能够生成物理合理的手部运动，并提供可解释的方差图来指示物理一致性较弱的位置，增强了手部运动估计的物理可信度。

title: Learnable Instance Attention Filtering for Adaptive Detector Distillation
summary: As deep vision models grow increasingly complex to achieve higher performance, deployment efficiency has become a critical concern. Knowledge distillation (KD) mitigates this issue by transferring knowledge from large teacher models to compact student models. While many feature-based KD methods rely on spatial filtering to guide distillation, they typically treat all object instances uniformly, ignoring instance-level variability. Moreover, existing attention filtering mechanisms are typically heuristic or teacher-driven, rather than learned with the student. To address these limitations, we propose Learnable Instance Attention Filtering for Adaptive Detector Distillation (LIAF-KD), a novel framework that introduces learnable instance selectors to dynamically evaluate and reweight instance importance during distillation. Notably, the student contributes to this process based on its evolving learning state. Experiments on the KITTI and COCO datasets demonstrate consistent improvements, with a 2% gain on a GFL ResNet-50 student without added complexity, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出LIAF-KD框架，通过可学习的实例注意力过滤机制，让学生模型参与评估实例重要性，实现自适应检测器蒸馏，在KITTI和COCO数据集上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 随着深度视觉模型复杂度增加，部署效率成为关键问题。现有特征蒸馏方法通常对所有对象实例统一处理，忽略了实例级差异，且注意力过滤机制多是启发式或教师驱动的，没有让学生参与学习过程。
AI.method: 提出LIAF-KD框架，引入可学习的实例选择器，动态评估和重新加权蒸馏过程中的实例重要性。关键创新是让学生基于其学习状态参与这一过程，实现自适应蒸馏。
AI.result: 在KITTI和COCO数据集上的实验显示，该方法在GFL ResNet-50学生模型上获得2%的性能提升，且不增加额外复杂度，优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: LIAF-KD通过让学生参与实例重要性评估，实现了更有效的检测器知识蒸馏，为复杂视觉模型的高效部署提供了新思路。

title: CD-Buffer: Complementary Dual-Buffer Framework for Test-Time Adaptation in Adverse Weather Object Detection
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enables real-time adaptation to domain shifts without off-line retraining. Recent TTA methods have predominantly explored additive approaches that introduce lightweight modules for feature refinement. Recently, a subtractive approach that removes domain-sensitive channels has emerged as an alternative direction. We observe that these paradigms exhibit complementary effectiveness patterns: subtractive methods excel under severe shifts by removing corrupted features, while additive methods are effective under moderate shifts requiring refinement. However, each paradigm operates effectively only within limited shift severity ranges, failing to generalize across diverse corruption levels. This leads to the following question: can we adaptively balance both strategies based on measured feature-level domain shift? We propose CD-Buffer, a novel complementary dual-buffer framework where subtractive and additive mechanisms operate in opposite yet coordinated directions driven by a unified discrepancy metric. Our key innovation lies in the discrepancy-driven coupling: Our framework couples removal and refinement through a unified discrepancy metric, automatically balancing both strategies based on feature-level shift severity. This establishes automatic channel-wise balancing that adapts differentiated treatment to heterogeneous shift magnitudes without manual tuning. Extensive experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and ACDC datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, consistently achieving superior results across diverse weather conditions and severity levels.

AI.tldr: CD-Buffer是一个互补双缓冲框架，通过统一的差异度量自适应平衡减法和加法策略，实现跨不同域偏移程度的测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法存在局限性：减法方法在严重域偏移下有效但无法处理中等偏移，加法方法在中等偏移下有效但无法处理严重偏移。需要一种能自适应平衡两种策略的框架。
AI.method: 提出CD-Buffer框架，包含减法（移除域敏感通道）和加法（特征细化）两个互补机制，通过统一的差异度量驱动两者协调工作，实现基于特征级偏移严重程度的自适应平衡。
AI.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes和ACDC数据集上的实验表明，该方法在各种天气条件和严重程度下都取得了最先进的性能，实现了跨不同域偏移程度的稳定优异表现。
AI.conclusion: CD-Buffer通过统一的差异度量耦合减法和加法策略，实现了自适应通道级平衡，能够处理异构的偏移程度而无需手动调参，为测试时自适应提供了更通用的解决方案。

title: Beyond Where to Look: Trajectory-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal RLVR
summary: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have mainly focused on improving final answer correctness and strengthening visual grounding. However, a critical bottleneck remains: although models can attend to relevant visual regions, they often fail to effectively incorporate visual evidence into subsequent reasoning, leading to reasoning chains that are weakly grounded in visual facts. To address this issue, we propose Trajectory-Guided Reinforcement Learning (TGRL), which guides the policy model to integrate visual evidence into fine-grained reasoning processes using expert reasoning trajectories from stronger models. We further introduce token-level reweighting and trajectory filtering to ensure stable and effective policy optimization. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that TGRL consistently improves reasoning performance and effectively bridges the gap between visual perception and logical reasoning.

AI.tldr: TGRL通过专家推理轨迹指导策略模型将视觉证据整合到细粒度推理过程中，解决MLLMs中视觉感知与逻辑推理脱节的问题
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法主要关注最终答案正确性和视觉定位，但模型虽然能关注相关视觉区域，却经常无法有效将视觉证据整合到后续推理中，导致推理链与视觉事实联系薄弱
AI.method: 提出轨迹引导强化学习（TGRL），使用更强模型的专家推理轨迹指导策略模型将视觉证据整合到细粒度推理过程，并引入token级重加权和轨迹过滤以确保稳定有效的策略优化
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准测试上的广泛实验表明，TGRL能持续提升推理性能，有效弥合视觉感知与逻辑推理之间的差距
AI.conclusion: TGRL通过专家轨迹引导的强化学习框架，成功解决了MLLMs中视觉证据与推理过程脱节的关键瓶颈问题
